summary: Replaced the three prototype patches (`onExecuted`, `configure`, `onConfigure`) with `comfy.defs.extend(...)` + `onExecuted`/`onConfigured`; the `VALUES` symbol goes away because `onConfigured` receives the serialised node data with `widgets_values` intact. `this.widgets.length = isConvertedWidget` becomes `node.widgets.remove(name)` per widget past the converted-widget slot (detected via `input.isWidgetInput` rather than `+!!inputs[0].widget`), so each removal now runs teardown and clears the widget render order. Readouts are `widgets.add({ type: 'textarea', disabled: true })` instead of `ComfyWidgets["STRING"]` + `inputEl.readOnly`/`opacity`. Dropped the rAF resize block (`computeSize`/`onResize`/`setDirtyCanvas`): `onResize` is a notification, not a setter, so it never resized the node, and `addWidget` already calls `expandToFitContent`. Dropped the `widgets_values.slice(+(len > 1 && inputs[0].widget))` index — `input.widget` is an object, so the coercion was always 0 or NaN and the slice always started at 0.

results.detail: No net-new members outside the API.
